description: This file defines an AutoMapper profile for mapping domain entities to Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) in the PublicApi layer, specifying mappings for CatalogItem, CatalogType, and CatalogBrand entities.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A Profile subclass configuring entity-to-DTO mappings for the API layer.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the mapping configurations using CreateMap and ForMember for custom property mappings.
